review.finding: A compact three-panel braid diagram would clarify the two stacked words, their common endpoint permutation, and the rigid half-turn model. This is a useful illustration of the explicit construction, not a defect inferred from missing art.
review.word_order: The source says the right factor is stacked below. Thus W0 = sigma1 star (sigma2 star sigma1) is traversed bottom-to-top as sigma1, sigma2, sigma1; W1 = sigma2 star (sigma1 star sigma2) is traversed bottom-to-top as sigma2, sigma1, sigma2. The relation is symmetric, so reversing these palindromic words leaves the written order unchanged.
review.crossing_sequence: Reading each stacking stage as its adjacent half twist, W0 swaps positions (1 2), then (2 3), then (1 2); W1 swaps (2 3), then (1 2), then (2 3). The two generator types have opposite planar locations but the source does not assign an over/under projection convention; a diagram should derive crossing style from the cited half-twist definition rather than invent one.
review.endpoint_permutation: For the stated convention (pi composed with sigma)(j) = pi(sigma(j)), both composites evaluate to (1 3). The endpoint tuple is (q3,q2,q1) in both cases; the middle strand endpoint is q2.
review.rotation_and_disjointness: The rotation u -> R_(pi u)(p_k) is a collision-free braid: rotations preserve pairwise distances and keep all points within radius 1/8. The source's explicit Z(s,u) interpolation has fixed bottom and top tuples and checks collision-freeness at u=0, 1/2, 1. Those sample checks alone do not prove Z collision-free for every (s,u); the isotopy conclusion is instead supported by cited Fact [F1], which states the geometric lemma supplies the braid isotopies. A diagram can illustrate positions/crossing order but cannot certify that global isotopy.
review.directions_and_conventions: The time parameter u is vertical in a braid diagram, with initial Q at the bottom and (q3,q2,q1) at the top. Keep braid word order consistent with the right-factor-below stacking definition and permutation composition convention recorded in [F2]-[F3].
review.diagram_specification: If added, show W0 and W1 as separate bottom-to-top strands with the three adjacent half twists in the sequences above, alongside the half-turn rot from Q to (q3,q2,q1). Label endpoint strands or annotate the induced permutation (1 3); do not use the schematic as proof of the two-parameter interpolation's collision-freeness.
